subject: Redwood POC Plan — Acme Corp (success criteria, timeline, owners)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood POC Plan — Acme Corp (success criteria, timeline, owners)

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the call today — great alignment on objectives. As promised, outlined below is the draft POC plan and suggested success criteria so we can lock the scope and owners. Please review and let me know if anything needs to change.

Summary / goal:
- Validate Redwood inference reduces per-token cost by >=30% for your throughput profile while meeting 95th percentile latency <=200ms for 512-token contexts.

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Cost: >=30% reduction in per-token inference cost compared to current vendor baseline under the test workload.
2) Latency: P95 <=200ms for single-user interactive sessions (512-token context).
3) Quality: no more than a 5% regression on your production prompt set (we'll use the 50 core prompts you shared).
4) Stability: zero hard failures for 48 hours at target throughput.

Evaluation plan & timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): Kickoff, environment access, and data share (you provide anonymized prompt set + sample records).
- Week 1: Baseline capture and initial Redwood config (quantization profile, batching).
- Week 2: Load testing + latency/cost runs; iterate on kernels and batching.
- Week 3: Quality evaluation and final report; go/no-go decision.

Ownership / next steps:
- Acme: Provide anonymized prompt set and sample API keys for sandbox by Fri 02/27 — owner: Emma.
- Redwood SE: Rishi to provision dedicated sandbox, config templates, and run baseline scripts — owner: Rishi.
- CSM: Laura to coordinate weekly check-ins and collect quality feedback — owner: Laura.
- AE: I (Marissa) will manage timelines, procurement questions, and exec updates.

Attachments: attached 'redwood-poc-plan.pdf' (detailed runbook) and 'evaluation-metrics-template.xlsx' (to collect results).

Please reply with any edits to criteria or timeline and confirm owners. Once we have agreement I'll open the HubSpot milestone and send calendar invites for weekly status.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199
